title: MOSFET conduction loss and thermal chain starter

provenance.citation: IEC 60747 semiconductor device terminology and JEDEC JESD51 thermal measurement practice
provenance.note: Starter pack contains model structure only; every device value must come from a revision-bound datasheet.

terminology.definition: Drain-source on-state resistance at a stated gate voltage, drain current and junction temperature.

provenance.note: Conditional on gate drive and temperature; it is not a universal constant.

terminology.definition: The series path Rth(j-c) + Rth(c-s) + Rth(s-a), including the interface and mounting conditions.
A self-heating instability where the temperature-dependent loss grows faster than the thermal path can remove it.

provenance.note: The instability threshold must be evaluated with the actual Rds(on) temperature coefficient and thermal path.

models.name: Coupled conduction loss and steady-state thermal chain

provenance.citation: IEC 60747-8 and JEDEC JESD51 model structure
provenance.note: The coupled fixed point is solved explicitly; no iterative black box is hidden.
R_th(c-s) must include the actual interface material and mounting condition.
A single linear coefficient is a local model; the datasheet curve defines its validity.

assumptions.statement: Only conduction loss is modeled; switching, gate-drive, body-diode, avalanche and leakage losses are excluded unless separately supplied.

provenance.note: Excluded losses are not zero by assumption in a complete design; they are outside this model.

assumptions.statement: Rds(on) varies linearly with junction temperature over the selected interval using the supplied alpha.

provenance.citation: Manufacturer datasheet Rds(on) vs temperature curve
provenance.note: Outside the datasheet interval the linear coefficient is not valid.

assumptions.statement: The thermal resistances are constant and represent the actual mounting, interface material, heatsink and airflow condition.

provenance.note: A datasheet Rth without its measurement condition is not a design value.

validity_domains.statement: Junction temperature, current and gate voltage must remain inside the revision-bound manufacturer datasheet range used for Rds(on) and alpha.
exclusions: gate voltage below the datasheet test condition
junction temperature outside the datasheet curve

validity_domains.statement: The thermal chain is only valid when junction-to-case, case-to-sink (interface) and sink-to-ambient resistances are all sourced for the actual assembly.
exclusions: natural convection assumed where forced convection is required

provenance.note: A missing contact resistance is unknown, never zero.

property_sources.authority: Revision-bound manufacturer datasheet at the stated gate voltage and current
Revision-bound datasheet plus JESD51 measurement condition
Interface material datasheet with pressure, thickness and voiding condition

provenance.note: A missing interface resistance makes the junction temperature unavailable.

design_rules.rule: Include the case-to-sink interface resistance; do not treat a missing interface value as zero.
Compare the converged junction temperature with the datasheet maximum and report margin as unavailable when either is missing.
Check the steady-state thermal stability denominator before solving; a non-positive denominator is a runaway condition, not a numeric result.

manufacturing_rules.rule: Control interface material thickness, application pressure and voiding because they dominate Rth(c-s).
manufacturing_rules.check: assembly instruction and first-article thermal measurement

manufacturing_rules.rule: Respect the device mounting torque and flatness specification; excess or uneven pressure damages the package or interface.
manufacturing_rules.check: mounting torque and heatsink flatness records

failure_modes.cause: self-heating raises Rds(on), which raises loss faster than the thermal path removes it
failure_modes.detection: stability denominator check, thermal imaging, current-limited test

failure_modes.cause: pump-out, voiding, contamination or inadequate mounting pressure
failure_modes.detection: rising case-to-ambient delta, thermal cycling test, teardown inspection

failure_modes.cause: load fault, gate-drive fault or insufficient current limiting
failure_modes.detection: current sensing, desaturation detection, fuse coordination

diagnostic_signatures.signature: Rds(on) or conduction loss drifting upward with temperature
diagnostic_signatures.indicates: positive temperature coefficient self-heating; check the coupled solution and stability denominator

test_methods.method: JESD51 thermal resistance measurement on the actual package and board
Loaded thermal soak with case, sink and ambient temperature logging
test_methods.measures: steady-state temperature rise and thermal path consistency

provenance.citation: Closed-form solution of the coupled conduction-thermal fixed point
provenance.note: Values follow from the equations and supplied inputs, not from a hidden device database.

counterexamples.claim: Using Rds(on) at 25 degC in the loss equation is accurate enough for a hot junction.
counterexamples.refutation: The loss and Rds(on) are coupled. Solving T_j = T_a + P(T_j) R_th changes both the loss and the hot resistance; evaluating only at 25 degC systematically understates temperature.

provenance.citation: Manufacturer MOSFET datasheet Rds(on) vs temperature

known_traps.trap: Summing only junction-to-case and sink-to-ambient thermal resistance, or silently treating the missing case-to-sink interface as zero.
known_traps.why_shallow_fails: The arithmetic and units look correct, but the omitted interface can dominate the temperature rise. A missing value is unknown, not zero.
known_traps.guard: Require a revision-bound Rth(c-s) or return a typed unavailable junction temperature.
